bill.title: To direct the Secretary of Agriculture to submit to Congress a report on barriers to participation in Department of Agriculture programs faced by certified organic farms and farms that may be interested in transitioning to organic production, and for other purposes.
bill.latestActionText: Referred to the House Committee on Agriculture.

classification.plainSummary: This bill requires the Secretary of Agriculture to submit a report to Congress identifying barriers that prevent certified organic farms and farms interested in transitioning to organic production from participating in USDA programs. The report would examine obstacles these farms face when trying to access existing Department of Agriculture assistance and services. The bill is a reporting requirement and does not itself change any programs or regulations.

industries.rationale: The bill directly addresses barriers faced by organic farms and farms transitioning to organic production in accessing USDA programs.

method.formula: score = Σ_industries ( donorShare(industry) × billWeight(industry) ), where billWeight = classifierConfidence / Σ classifierConfidence. Range 0–1, read as a weighted share of disclosed itemized money.

disclaimer: This tool places two public records next to each other: who donated to a member of Congress, and what that member legislated on. Any overlap you see is a correlation, not causation. It is not evidence of a quid pro quo, of influence, or of wrongdoing. Legislators routinely receive support from industries in their district for the same reason they legislate on them: those industries are there.
